title: Cinema seat holds
tagline: Two people get the same seat, failed holds keep seats locked, old holds never expire, and late confirms go through.
lookFor: Taking a seat must be ONE database step that says 'only if free'.
If seat 3 fails, give back seats 1 and 2.
A hold that has run out of time counts as free.
Check the hold is still valid when confirming.

bugs.symptom: Two concurrent holds both get seat A1
hints: Both read 'free' before either saves. Is there a one-step update?
bugs.cause: Read, check, then save. Two people slip in between.
bugs.fix: Per seat: `seats.findOneAndUpdate({ _id, status: 'free' }, { $set: { status: 'held', ... } })`. null = taken.

bugs.symptom: Failed hold leaves earlier seats held
hints: If A2 is taken, what happened to A1?
bugs.cause: Seats are taken one by one, and nothing gives them back on failure.
bugs.fix: Remember taken seats. On failure, set them back to `free`.

hints: When is a 'held' seat actually free?
bugs.cause: Only `free` counts. Expired holds block the seat forever.

bugs.symptom: Hidden test: Confirming an expired hold succeeds
bugs.cause: An old hold can still be confirmed.
bugs.fix: If the hold has run out of time, return 410.
